data.comment:
# Comfy Ideogram v4- Text to Image (API)

Input a text prompt in structured JSON format. Generate a high-quality image with precise layout control, text rendering, and color palette support. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_ideogram_v4_t2i.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
